article.title: Arrest to be made strictly according to Sanhita
article.content: No arrest shall be made except in accordance with the provisions of this Sanhita or any other law for the time being in force providing for arrest.
article.html:
62Arrest to be made strictly according to Sanhita

Section 62 · Chapter V
